summary_1line: Vyasa teaches that Brahmanas must study the Vedas, practice self‑control, perform sacrifices and charity, and live righteously to cross the perilous stream of worldly existence.

image_candidates.scene_text: A disciplined Brahmana sits before a sacred fire offering oblations while reciting the Vedas at dawn.
A symbolic river of life rages with waters formed by the five senses while a sage strives to cross it with calm determination.
Time looms behind humanity as a vast shadowy figure armed with irresistible force, watching over the world.
